description: The two airline-agent decisions this room holds, declared side by side with no edge between them: the policy states no relationship in which one decision's outcome is an input to the other, and every candidate coupling is recorded in RESIDUE.md instead of being wired.

change-cabin.description: May the cabin be changed for this reservation, and if so is the price difference collected from or refunded to the user? (Modify flight > Change cabin.)

refunds-and-compensation.description: Is the user owed a refund or compensation, and what kind? (Refunds and Compensation; this pack answers the compensation half and asserts no refund.)
